cohort: The study included 36 patients with classic CAH and 27 control women matched for age, race, and marital status.
finding: Patients with CAH were more likely to experience sexual dysfunction, dyspareunia, other pelvic pain, poorer body image, and worse HRQoL compared to controls, but a larger vaginal caliber was associated with better sexual function and HRQoL outcomes in CAH patients.
